display.title: Parshas Noach: The Lesson of Honesty
display.summary_short: The generation of the Flood was punished for robbery, so every year Parshas Noach reminds us to be honest and to set an example for others.
display.summary_long: A short parsha talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show. Uncle Yossi recalls the Alter Rebbe's teaching that we must 'live with the times', and the Mitteler Rebbe's explanation that this means living with the weekly sedra, since each parsha holds a living lesson for today. In Parshas Noach, Hashem brought the Flood because the earth was filled with chamas, which Rashi explains means robbery: people stole from one another. So each year this parsha reminds us to work on the midah of honesty and to be a living example so that others will follow. The clip ends by promising a story about honesty, which is not included here.
display.lesson: Be honest, never take what is not yours, and be an example that others will follow.
